headline: Discussion of a median strip ordinance and Vision Zero update, plus reports on Commercial Street and Payson Park traffic projects.
summary: Greg Jordan will give a Vision Zero update and lead discussion of a median strip ordinance. Cashel Stewart of GPCOG will report on the Commercial Street pilot, and Megan Houdlette and Alex Marshall will report on Payson Park.
items: Vision Zero program update and discussion of median strip ordinance, presented by Greg Jordan
Commercial Street Safe Streets Pilot Project report, presented by Cashel Stewart of GPCOG
Payson Park Traffic Calming Demonstration Project report, presented by Megan Houdlette and Alex Marshall
